title: Employment transfer executed without a consent-regime determination
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/2026-08-24-class-c-decisions.md (gd-0024-class-c-decisions); var seeded by migration 0027 per ADR-0064 + employment_transfer_without_consent_determination wording (ADR-0060)
notes: declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). Escalation, not halt: the jurisdiction's employment-transfer regime (TUPE / Korean 영업양도 doctrine) must be determined and applied before people move; Korean succession is judicial doctrine (Supreme Court 2000다8448 line) — individual-consent path is the safe practice (ADR-0051, verify with counsel). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: legal.employment_transfer_consent_regime_determined (boolean — a jurisdictional determination fact). ADR-0064 arms this: an ASSERTED var (dimension_input write path, reviewed-only) — the jurisdictional determination is a human fact, not derivable; asserted 'not_determined' at this gate escalates.
